math.add.no_regroup.description: Added each column but did not carry when a column made ten or more.
math.add.no_regroup.remediation_strategy: New additions that each need a carry, done ones column first, saying the carried ten aloud.
math.add.no_regroup.hint: Add the ones first. If they make ten or more, carry the ten to the next column.
math.add.no_regroup.parent_script: Ask them to say the ones total out loud before writing anything: "7 and 5 make 12, that's one ten and two ones."

math.sub.smaller_from_larger.description: Took the smaller digit from the larger in each column instead of regrouping.
math.sub.smaller_from_larger.remediation_strategy: New subtractions that each need regrouping, checking the top digit of each column first.
math.sub.smaller_from_larger.hint: Look at the top digit. If it is smaller than the one below, borrow a ten from the next column.
math.sub.smaller_from_larger.parent_script: Before each column, ask: "Is the top number big enough to take the bottom one away?"

math.mult.place_value_shift.description: In a two-digit multiplication, the second row was not moved one place to the left.
math.mult.place_value_shift.remediation_strategy: New two-digit multiplications, writing the placeholder zero before the second row.
math.mult.place_value_shift.hint: The second row is multiplying by tens, so start it with a zero in the ones place.
math.mult.place_value_shift.parent_script: Point at the tens digit and ask what it is worth: "Is that a 1 or a 10?"

math.fact_recall.remediation_strategy: Short retrieval of nearby facts from the same table, then mixed facts.
math.fact_recall.hint: If you are not sure, build it from a fact you know, like a double or a ten.
math.fact_recall.parent_script: If they hesitate, ask for a fact they do know nearby and build from it; do not time them.

math.operation_swap.description: Did a different operation from the one the sign asked for.
math.operation_swap.remediation_strategy: Problems of the asked-for operation, saying the sign aloud before starting.
math.operation_swap.hint: Say the sign out loud before you start.
math.operation_swap.parent_script: Ask them to read each problem aloud, sign included, before they work it.

math.fraction.add_across.description: Added (or subtracted) the numerators and the denominators separately.
math.fraction.add_across.remediation_strategy: Unlike-denominator problems, finding the common denominator first.
math.fraction.add_across.hint: Make the bottoms the same first. Only the tops are added.
math.fraction.add_across.parent_script: Ask: "Are these the same size pieces?" before any adding.

math.fraction.divide_no_invert.description: Multiplied straight across when the problem asked to divide.
math.fraction.divide_no_invert.remediation_strategy: Division of fractions, turning the second fraction over before multiplying.
math.fraction.divide_no_invert.hint: Dividing by a fraction is multiplying by it turned over.
math.fraction.divide_no_invert.parent_script: Ask how many quarters fit in a half; a picture helps more than the rule.

math.fraction.not_simplified.description: Right amount, not in the lowest terms the teacher asked for.
math.fraction.not_simplified.remediation_strategy: Simplify fractions by the greatest common factor.
math.fraction.not_simplified.hint: Find the biggest number that divides the top and bottom, and divide both by it.
math.fraction.not_simplified.parent_script: Praise that the amount is right, then ask whether it can be written more simply.

math.decimal.place_value.description: Digits right, decimal point in the wrong place.
math.decimal.place_value.remediation_strategy: Decimal problems, estimating the size of the answer first.
math.decimal.place_value.hint: Estimate first: about how big should the answer be?
math.decimal.place_value.parent_script: Ask for a rough estimate before they calculate, then check the point against it.

math.integer.sign.description: Right size, wrong sign, or a negative number treated as positive.
math.integer.sign.remediation_strategy: Integer problems on a number line, saying which way each step moves.
math.integer.sign.hint: Picture a number line. Which way does this move you?
math.integer.sign.parent_script: Draw a quick number line and let them walk it.

math.order_of_operations.description: Worked left to right instead of multiplying or dividing first.
math.order_of_operations.remediation_strategy: Mixed-operation problems, circling the multiplication or division first.
math.order_of_operations.hint: Circle the × or ÷ and do it first.
math.order_of_operations.parent_script: Ask them to circle the part they will do first before writing anything.

math.unclassified.description: A miss this pack cannot explain, or a problem it cannot work out; the parent is asked.
math.unclassified.remediation_strategy: Parent describes what went wrong; nothing is said to the child.

strengths.math.order_of_operations: Order of operations was right every time
